|lore=Threepio’s extensive experience ‘talking’ to the Falcon’s computer allowed him to pilot the freighter while on Coruscant. Artoo, an R-unit droid, provided moral support.<ref name="foil-face" />
|game_text=May pilot only Falcon. All droids may be battled. Any player that has no ability in a battle takes no battle damage. Once per turn, may take one card with “Bad Feeling” in title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Bad Feeling Have I is suspended.<ref name="foil-face" />
